question: Should OpenClaw accept this quick/full selectable PR-template workflow as part of the contributor authoring path?
rationale: The Markdown is technically sound, but shortening the external contributor template changes the repository’s evidence and review-context workflow, so a person who owns that policy should accept or reject it.

options.title: Land the current split
options.body: Accept the two optional templates plus fallback URL guidance as the new low-risk contributor path.

options.title: Require contributor-doc follow-up
options.body: Ask for a small `CONTRIBUTING.md` update before merge if maintainers want the selection path documented outside the hidden fallback-template comment.

options.title: Keep one fallback template
options.body: Reject the template split if maintainers want one consistent PR authoring contract for all external contributors.

recommendation.title: Land the current split
recommendation.body: Accept the two optional templates plus fallback URL guidance as the new low-risk contributor path.

likelyOwner.reason: Template history most strongly points to `Takhoffman` as the contributor PR-template area owner for this decision.
